product_metadata.title: Oggi Stack 'N Store 4 Piece Canister Set, White
features: 4 Piece Stack n' Store acrylic canister set
One touch easy lift off lids; airtight; superior lid locks to keep contents fresh
description: The Stack n' Store 4-pc. Canister Set is an easy solution for storing your dry goods. The simple, plastic, stackable canisters feature easy-off lids and superior lid locks. Pasta, cereal, flour or coffee all stay fresh in the airtight storage of the Stack 'n Store 4-pc. Canister Set. Easy to fit in your pantry or cupboards, this simple design also looks great on display. Dishwasher safe. Imported. 9-1/2Hx6" dia. 8Hx5-1/4" dia. 6-1/2Hx4-1/2" dia. 5-1/4Hx4" dia.
